coverage_policy_notes: Research target is 3–5 editorially independent Sources per political planning segment and per broadcast form. Genuine UK market gaps remain explicit. Shared ownership, common production companies or common news-supply infrastructure do not merge editorially distinct newsrooms.

provenance_policy.notes: A–F planning placement is not itself a persisted FSC political classification. Public-service status, religious identity, ownership and presenter ideology are never automatically converted into a Source-level political classification.

groups.label: radical/system-oppositional left
groups.coverage_exception: No approved nationally oriented UK linear television or radio newsroom is placed here. Digital-native outlets such as Novara Media belong in a later digital-video/podcast block.

groups.label: left/centre-left/left-liberal

entries.name: Channel 4 News

classifications.classifier_name: Media Influence Matrix / Media and Journalism Research Center
classifications.notes: The UK Media Influence Matrix describes Channel 4 News as more internationalist and liberal in editorial orientation than BBC and ITV News, especially in story selection. External academic attribution, not an FSC assessment.
Current external media-rating classification. FSC stores the attribution and does not adopt MBFC factuality judgments.

notes: ITN produces Channel 4 News, but ITN states that ITV News, Channel 4 News and 5 News are separate newsrooms with distinct editorial voices and missions.

groups.coverage_exception: One approved independent national television newsroom is placed in B. No national radio Source is moved into B merely to satisfy the research target.

groups.label: liberal/centre/public-service-and-mainstream reference

entries.name: BBC News
notes: BBC News is treated as one cross-media news Source for central television news and BBC Radio 4 news/current-affairs programmes produced by BBC News.
The C placement is a public-service reference position, not a persisted ideological classification.

entries.name: ITV News
notes: ITN supplies ITV News, but ITV News is kept as its own editorial Source because ITN and parliamentary evidence describe the national ITN newsrooms as editorially distinct.
C is a mainstream-reference planning position, not a persisted ideological classification.

entries.name: 5 News
notes: 5 News is an editorially separate ITN newsroom with its own editor and mission; shared ITN production does not collapse it into ITV News or Channel 4 News.
C is a mainstream-reference planning position, not a persisted ideological classification.

entries.name: Sky News
notes: National UK television news Source with its own newsroom. Sky News Radio is not modeled as a consumer radio Source because it primarily supplies bulletins to commercial radio stations.
C is a mainstream-reference planning position, not a persisted ideological classification.

entries.name: BBC Radio 5 Live
notes: BBC Radio 5 Live is modeled separately from BBC News because it has station-level controller, commissioning and editorial structures.
The C placement is a public-service reference position, not a persisted ideological classification.

groups.coverage_exception: The television side reaches the research target through distinct mainstream/public-service newsrooms. Radio remains sparse because BBC News and BBC Radio 5 Live are the only approved C Sources; other national speech stations remain politically unclassified.

groups.label: conservative/liberal-conservative
groups.coverage_exception: No approved independent national television or radio Source is placed in D. Religious broadcasters are not classified as conservative merely from Christian identity.

groups.label: right/right-conservative/right-libertarian

entries.name: GB News

classifications.classifier_name: Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2024 – United Kingdom
classifications.notes: Reuters Institute describes GB News as a right-leaning TV news channel. External attribution, not an FSC assessment.
Current external media-rating classification. FSC stores the orientation attribution and does not adopt MBFC factuality judgments.

notes: GB News television and radio are treated as outlets of one cross-media editorial Source.
External sources support E-direction placement; Ofcom impartiality decisions are regulatory evidence and are not used as political-classification substitutes.

groups.coverage_exception: GB News is the only approved national Source in E and spans both television and radio. No other Source is moved into E merely to meet a quota.

groups.label: radical right/externally classified extreme-right spectrum
groups.coverage_exception: No approved national UK television or radio newsroom currently satisfies FSC's two-independent-source threshold for F. Market gaps remain explicit.

unclassified_entries.name: Revelation TV

classifications.notes: Christian self-positioning is stored separately and does not establish a political FSC classification.

notes: Included because recurring programmes cover national and international news, politics and current affairs from a Christian perspective. Religious identity is not automatically conservative.

unclassified_entries.name: LBC
notes: National speech/current-affairs Source with its own Managing Editor across radio and digital. Presenter-level political positions are not generalized into a Source-level classification.

unclassified_entries.name: LBC News
notes: Rolling-news service with a distinct station/editorial operation. Shared Global newsroom infrastructure and bulletins do not merge LBC News with LBC.

unclassified_entries.name: Times Radio
notes: Times Radio draws on journalism from The Times and The Sunday Times but has its own Programme Director, schedule, production team and editorial contacts; it is therefore a separate Source rather than an outlet of the existing The Times print Source.
No political classification is inherited automatically from The Times.

unclassified_entries.name: Talk
notes: Current national radio/digital speech Source. The former linear TalkTV television service is not treated as a current TV Source.
Opinionated presenters or programmes are insufficient for a Source-level E classification without two independent external orientation sources.

unclassified_entries.name: UCB

classifications.notes: Christian self-positioning is stored separately and does not establish a political FSC classification.

notes: One editorial Source with two national radio outlets. Included because UCB describes in-depth news and discussion as part of the service.

unclassified_entries.name: Premier Christian Radio

classifications.notes: Christian self-positioning is stored separately and does not establish a political FSC classification.

notes: National Christian speech/news radio Source. Premier Praise and Premier Gospel are not counted as additional political Sources.
